interpretation.no_path_meaning: No eligible bounded shared-surface path is documented in the compiled corpus; this does not establish that no relationship or structural pattern exists.

layers.label: Documented fact
layers.definition: A bounded factual statement tied to inspectable provenance and scoped to what that evidence supports.
layers.permitted_language: State the supported fact with its dates, scope, evidence class, and source lifecycle.
layers.forbidden_inference: Do not extend a documented role, transaction, or appearance into motive, coordination, or causation without separate evidence.

layers.label: Structural signal
layers.definition: A repeated topology, public/private crossing, capital-flow pattern, personnel continuity, or other observable configuration that warrants comparison or research.
layers.permitted_language: Describe the observed structure, recurrence, comparison set, and limitations.
layers.forbidden_inference: Do not present structural similarity, co-presence, or recurrence as guilt, coordination, or motive.

layers.label: Temporal and outcome sequence
layers.definition: A dated sequence connecting public decisions, roles, programs, capital, deployments, and later outcomes without automatically asserting causation.
layers.permitted_language: State ordering, overlap, association, and source-explicit causal language separately.
layers.forbidden_inference: Do not convert before-and-after ordering into a causal verdict.

layers.label: Evidence attrition
layers.definition: A recorded change, disappearance, de-indexing, loss, or contest affecting previously observed evidence.
layers.permitted_language: State what was observed, when it was captured, its preserved hash or archive, and what later changed or disappeared.
layers.forbidden_inference: Do not infer who caused the attrition or why from disappearance alone.

layers.label: Investigative hypothesis
layers.definition: A clearly marked question or motif-based lead generated from the discovery map for further testing.
layers.permitted_language: Frame the item as a testable question, name the motif and disconfirming evidence, and route it to research.
layers.forbidden_inference: Do not publish a hypothesis as a fact or use a known-positive motif as a guilt template.
